prompts: A release added release_note and this adapter started quarantining otherwise valid records. Fix it according to the documented lossless contract. Keep required-field validation.
The next release also adds nested quality metadata. Ensure it survives without a special-case field allowlist and that the original id/name and release_note data are still retained.

files.README.md: parse_records accepts a list of record objects. id must be an integer excluding bool, and name must be a string. This is a lossless source adapter: arbitrary additive publisher fields, including nested values, are retained verbatim. Unknown fields are not an error. Missing or mistyped required fields are errors. Do not mutate caller records.

checks.name: lossless-and-validated
command:
from copy import deepcopy
from records import parse_records
rows=[{'id':7,'name':'North','release_note':'reissued','quality':{'status':'provisional','codes':[1,2]}}]
before=deepcopy(rows)
assert parse_records(rows)==rows
assert rows==before
for bad in [{'id':True,'name':'Bad'},{'id':1},{'id':'1','name':'Bad'}]:
 try:parse_records([bad])
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('Invalid required field accepted')
assert parse_records([])==[]

rubric: Retain arbitrary additive publisher fields without weakening the required id/name contract or mutating inputs. Later metadata must not erase the earlier release_note requirement.
